meta_title: Brush Hour Painting | Painter & Decorator Leeds
meta_description: Brush Hour Painting Co. brings expert interior and exterior painting to Leeds. Same-week appointments, quality finishes, competitive rates. Call us today.
hero_subhead: Professional painting and decorating across Leeds—from feature walls to full house transformations. We get the job right first time.
services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior feature walls and kitchen makeovers to exterior renders and commercial building work.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms painted to a flawless finish. We protect your furniture and flooring, clean up daily, and leave no mess.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes that protect your home's facade. From masonry paint to rendered walls, we use only premium paints suited to Leeds weather.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Expert wallpaper selection and installation on feature walls or whole rooms. We strip old paper cleanly and hang new paper with precision.

services.title: Feature Walls & Murals
services.desc: Create impact with bold colours, textured finishes, or custom murals. We'll help you choose the right look and execute it flawlessly.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office refreshes, retail fit-outs, and industrial spaces. We work around your schedule with minimal disruption and professional project management.

services.title: Prep & Repairs
services.desc: Cracks filled, surfaces sanded, and woodwork repaired before painting. Proper preparation ensures a finish that lasts years, not months.

about_pullquote: Good paint work should be invisible—you notice the walls, not the brush strokes.
about_para_1: Brush Hour Painting Co. was founded over a decade ago by a frustrated homeowner tired of cowboys and cowgirl decorators in Leeds. We started small—one van, one vision—and grew by word of mouth because we actually turned up on time and finished on time. Today we've completed over 2,000 projects across Leeds, from Victorian terrace renovations to modern apartment makeovers.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on three things: honest quotes with no hidden costs, preparation that takes longer than the paint job itself, and finishes you'll still be proud of years later. We're insured, fully vetted, and most of our work comes from existing customers recommending us to their mates. That's how you know we're doing something right.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Brush Hour

reviews.text: Had our entire hallway and staircase painted. Mark and the lads did a brilliant job—took three days, absolutely no mess, and the finish is perfect. They matched the original paint colour without faffing about. Will definitely have them back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed our exterior rendering painted before winter. Got a quote within two days and they fitted us in the next week. Weather was dodgy but they didn't cut corners. Really professional outfit. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Just had our kitchen painted as part of a refurb. The team protected everything properly and the colour looks even better than I imagined. They sorted out a few dodgy bits on the plaster too without charging extra. Top-quality work at a fair price.
reviews.author: Michael T.
